psnd_bn.method_note: PSND ex, £bn: end-March 2024 value of ONS CDID HF6W.

psnd_pct_gdp.method_note: PSND ex as % of GDP (ONS GDP centred on March): end-March 2024 value of ONS CDID HF6X.

baseline_psnb_bn.method_note: 2025-26: outturn (ons_psf, ons_psf); later years: OBR forecast.

baseline_psnd_pct_gdp.method_note: 2025-26: outturn (ons_psf, ons_psf); later years: OBR forecast.

baseline_nominal_growth_pct.method_note: Average annual growth of OBR nominal GDP, 2025-26 to 2030-31 (EFO-2026-03).

receipts.label: Income tax
receipts.method_note: PAYE (MS6W) + self assessment (LISB) + other income tax (MF6X); excludes capital gains tax (MS62), which ONS includes in its income tax total (LIBR). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: National Insurance
receipts.method_note: Social contributions (AIIH) minus the immigration health surcharge (FTA6) that ONS records within them. ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: VAT
receipts.method_note: VAT net of VAT refunds to public bodies (CTRU); the refunds (AHGO) are in other_taxes. ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Corporation tax
receipts.method_note: Onshore corporation tax (CPSC, incl. bank surcharge, residential property developer tax and diverted profits tax) + offshore corporation tax (CPSB) minus the energy profits levy (JIS6) that ONS records within offshore CT. ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Council tax
receipts.method_note: Council tax (NMHM). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Business rates
receipts.method_note: Business rates (CUKY). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024. ONS outturn basis. The OBR forecast for later years uses a wider definition (about £3bn more in 2024-25), so the line steps up where outturn meets forecast.

receipts.label: Fuel duty
receipts.method_note: Fuel duties (CUDG). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Stamp duties
receipts.method_note: Stamp duty land tax (MM9F) + stamp taxes on shares (BKST). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Capital gains tax
receipts.method_note: Capital gains tax (MS62). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Alcohol & tobacco
receipts.method_note: Tobacco duties (GTAO) + alcohol duties (MF6V). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Inheritance tax
receipts.method_note: Inheritance tax (ACCH). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Other taxes
receipts.method_note: Total public sector taxes and social contributions (AHHY) minus the 11 named tax lines; equals the sum of the remaining rows: VAT refunds (AHGO), customs (FV2H), VED (EKED+CDDZ), other taxes on production (MF6W), PRT (ACCJ), energy profits levy (JIS6), misc. taxes on income and wealth (MF6Z), bank levy (KIH3), licence fee (DH7A), misc. other taxes excl. IHT (MF72-ACCH), immigration health surcharge (FTA6), other local government taxes (AHGR). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024.

receipts.label: Non-tax income
receipts.method_note: Public sector current receipts (JW2O) minus total taxes and social contributions (AHHY); equals interest and dividends (AHHZ) + gross operating surplus (JW2K) + other public sector receipts (AHIO). ONS PSF Appendix D, sum of the 12 monthly values Apr 2023 to Mar 2024. ONS outturn basis; it includes some receipts the OBR forecast shows under business rates.

borrowing_provenance.method_note: Total spending minus receipts (PSF-2026-09). Published borrowing for 2023-24: 135.2bn.

spending.label: Transport & economy
spending.desc: Roads, rail, buses, business support, R&D

spending.label: Running government
spending.method_note: COFOG general public services, excluding debt interest (PESA-2026).

spending.label: Housing & environment
spending.desc: Housing, local amenities, waste, flood defence
spending.method_note: COFOG housing and community amenities plus environment protection (PESA-2026).

spending.label: Debt interest
spending.desc: Interest on public debt, net of the Bank of England's asset purchases
spending.method_note: Central government debt interest net of the APF (OBR definition): ONS CG interest payable (NMFX, 83.0bn) minus APF net interest receivable (MDD8, -24.3bn), summed April 2023 to March 2024.

spending.label: Accounting adjustments
spending.desc: Items in total spending that are not spending on services: public corporations, locally financed items and national-accounts adjustments
spending.method_note: Reconciles spending by function (HMT PESA) with total spending. Made up of: HMT PESA accounting adjustments 115.8bn; 19.9bn that PESA counts as debt interest but the OBR measure used for the debt interest line does not (mostly 18.1bn of notional interest on unfunded public-service pensions); 1.0bn difference between total spending here (PSF-2026-09) and PESA's outturn.
